source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.5.1 with the Did you know box on Lahore smog, printed page 277.

blocks.text: Photochemical smog (Los Angeles smog) dhoop (sunlight) mein NOₓ aur volatile organic compounds (VOCs, yani aasani se vapour (bhaap) banne wale organic compounds) se atmosphere (fiza) mein banti hai. Yeh oxidising qism ki smog hai. Photochemical oxidants, jaise NO₂, ozone aur peroxyacyl nitrates (PANs), atmosphere mein kuch compounds se react kar ke unhen oxidise kar dete hain. NOₓ ka emission (bahar nikalna) barhne ki wajah se photochemical smog ab classical smog (London smog) se zyada aam ho rahi hai. Photochemical smog in reactions se banti hai:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Chain (zanjeer) yun chalti hai: engine mein N₂ aur O₂ se NO banti hai; NO hawa mein NO₂ ban jati hai; dhoop (hυ) NO₂ ko tor kar oxygen atom (O) nikalti hai; yeh O atom O₂ se mil kar ozone (O₃) banata hai; ozone hydrocarbons (RCH=RCH) par attack (hamla) karti hai aur radicals bante hain jo aakhir mein PAN, RC(O)OONO₂, tak le jate hain. Dhoop ke baghair teesra step (qadam) nahi hota, is liye ise 'photo'-chemical smog kehte hain.

blocks.title: Did you know? (kya aap jante hain)
blocks.text: Lahore ki smog mein volatile organic compounds (VOCs), NOₓ, ground level (zameen ke qareeb wali) ozone (O₃), particulate matter PM2.5 (bohat bareek particles), CO aur SO₂ hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Photochemical smog banne ke reactions likhein aur batayein ke dhoop kyun zaroori hai (exercise Q.2e).
blocks.explanation: N₂ + O₂ → 2NO; 2NO + O₂ → 2NO₂; NO₂ →(hυ) NO + O; O + O₂ → O₃; phir O₃ hydrocarbons se react kar ke radicals aur aakhir mein PAN banati hai. Dhoop NO₂ ko tor kar O atom deti hai jis se ozone banti hai; dhoop ke baghair yeh chain shuru hi nahi hoti.

blocks.prompt: Lahore ki smog mein kya kya hota hai, aur in mein se kaun si cheezen NOₓ se banti hain?
blocks.explanation: VOCs, NOₓ, ground level ozone, PM2.5, CO aur SO₂. Ozone aur PAN seedhe emission nahi; yeh dhoop mein NOₓ aur VOCs ke reactions se bante hain.

items: Photochemical (Los Angeles) smog: dhoop mein NOₓ + VOCs; oxidising (NO₂, O₃, PANs).
NO₂ →(hυ) NO + O; O + O₂ → O₃; O₃ hydrocarbons ko oxidise kar ke PAN tak le jati hai.
Lahore smog: VOCs, NOₓ, O₃, PM2.5, CO, SO₂.
